text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: D1/D2 are excluded (not commonly comparable between Track A and Track B); D3–D10 are paired per question.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: Mean (D3–D10): per-question Δᵢ = mean over d = 3…10 of (S_A − S_B), then paired mean with 95% CI (t).

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616a

g.text: Heatmaps (b)(c) use mean blind scores on D3–D10, n = 84 per track (Track D n = 80); the two judges are never averaged.
